notes.title: New update for Monster College!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, this release adds Chapter 9 to the game and closes the story of the game.
It is not the end, though: I'll keep adding and fixing a few scenes within the game, and will release extended ending scenes for each character. Hope you'll keep supporting the game and its V2 development!

Changelog:
-Fixed a bug at the end of Ch05: if Sofia's storyline doesn't close in your desired way, I suggest replaying from her ritual scene at the end of Ch05.
-Added about 15k words;
-Added about 650 images;
-Beta translations for  Chinese


To learn more about the game visit the community page.

notes.title: New update for Monster College!
notes.notes:
UPDATE v0.8.7


Hey everyone!
A new update is available, bringing the first half of Chapter 8 on Steam!
Completing the Chapter will still take a while, so in the meantime I hope you'll enjoy this first snippet of story!

Changelog:
-added over 18000 words
-added about 750 images
-added a new Main Menu screen
-added 6 animations
-lots of minor bug fixes for the end of Ch07
-added better FRN and RUS translations up to Ch07
-Beta translations for GER and ESP are up too 
-revised a few details in previous scenes (mostly audio and transition effects), will keep working more on them to raise the quality of the first chapters, where possible

notes.title: The new update for Monster College is here!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
A new update is available, bringing the whole of Chapter 7 on Steam!
It took a while, but it's the largest Chapter yet.
I hope you'll enjoy!

The update includes 20 new scenes with:
- over 42000 words
- over 1600 new images
- 19 new animations
- 7 new achievements
- various bug fixes

IT'S HALLOWEEN

notes.title: Updated release date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone guys! I wanted to announce that I am working on the game and I plan to add more content to the game and do a thorough quality check, so I decided to move the release date to July 18 2023.

I plan to keep you updated until the game's release with game information and news about developments.

Feel free to give me your opinion on what you would like to see in the game!
